introHtml: Gold shorts command attention, making them ideal for championship teams, award ceremonies, or branded giveaways that stand out. Whether you are outfitting a sales team for a conference or rewarding employees for hitting goals, these shorts pair well with white or black tees for a polished look. Choose screen printing or embroidery for your logo on performance fabrics or cotton blends.
